title: Smoked Salmon Kebabs
description: Delicious smoked salmon kebabs, perfect for a light and refreshing meal. Serve with a side of rye bread and a dollop of cream cheese.

ingredients.name: Fresh Dill
ingredients.notes: Chopped or leave whole for garnish

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Wooden Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before using

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before using.
Thread salmon, dill, and lemon juice onto skewers.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve with rye bread and a dollop of cream cheese.
